Romanesco Courgette - 2x Plug Plants - Interesting Variety
Italian Courgette Romanesco - A traditional variety originating from Rome, Italy, known for its distinctive appearance and superior taste. The plants produce mid-sized zucchini with characteristic raised ridges running along the length of the fruit. The flesh has a robust, nutty flavor that distinguishes it from common zucchini varieties. This variety is particularly valued for its exceptionally large flowers, which are perfect for the classic Italian preparation of stuffed and battered fried blossoms. The combination of flavorful fruit and abundant, sizeable flowers makes this an excellent choice for both harvesting young tender zucchini and utilizing the edible flowers in traditional Mediterranean cooking.
